note: Synthetic. India: an FIR, statements under s.161 Cr.P.C. (one supplementary, under an initial-only name), and examinations-in-chief, with one same-name different person (PW-5, needs counsel SPLIT), one initial-only alias (needs counsel MERGE) and one similar-name different person (Ramesh Yadav, must never be merged). US: a declaration and a deposition transcript (page:line). Contradictions are compared within ONE witness only, each later statement against the most recent earlier statement that speaks to the same matter. Precision traps are listed under expected.traps; no finding outside expected.findings may be produced.

FIRST INFORMATION REPORT
(Under Section 154 Cr.P.C.)

FIR No. 112/2023, P.S. Kotwali, District Agra

Date and time of report: 11.03.2023, 11:40 p.m.

Informant: Ramesh Kumar s/o Shyam Lal, aged 34 years, r/o Lohamandi, Agra

Statement of the informant:

On 11.03.2023 at about 9 p.m., I was returning home on foot near the Hanuman temple, Lohamandi. Three persons stopped me. One of them, Mohan, hit me on the head with a lathi. They snatched my bag containing Rs 5,000 and ran away towards the railway crossing.

I went to the police station at about 11.30 p.m. with my neighbour.

STATEMENT UNDER SECTION 161 Cr.P.C.

Statement of Ramesh Kumar s/o Shyam Lal recorded on 13.03.2023 at P.S. Kotwali

On the night of 11 March 2023 at around 9 pm I was returning home near the temple. Three men came and stopped me. They first snatched my bag and then Mohan hit me on my head with a lathi. The bag they snatched contained Rs. 5000/-.

My brother Suresh was not present at that time.

SUPPLEMENTARY STATEMENT UNDER SECTION 161 Cr.P.C.

Supplementary statement of R. Kumar recorded on 20.03.2023 at P.S. Kotwali

The police showed me my bag on 18.03.2023. It is the same bag that was snatched from me.

IN THE COURT OF THE ADDITIONAL SESSIONS JUDGE, AGRA
S.T. No. 45/2023  State v. Raju and others

PW-1 Ramesh Kumar
Examination-in-chief recorded on 20.01.2024

On 10.03.2023 at about 11 p.m. I was returning home on foot near the bus stand. Two men came and stopped me. They first hit me and then snatched my bag. Raju hit me on the head with a lathi. The bag they snatched contained Rs 15,000. My brother Suresh was with me and saw the incident. I clearly saw Raju's face in the light of the street lamp and I can identify him.

Thereafter I went to the police station with my neighbour at about 11:30 pm.

STATEMENT UNDER SECTION 161 Cr.P.C.

Statement of Smt. Sunita Devi w/o Rakesh recorded on 13.03.2023 at P.S. Kotwali

On 11.03.2023 at about 9 p.m. I heard shouts and came out of my house. I saw two or three persons running towards the railway crossing.

IN THE COURT OF THE ADDITIONAL SESSIONS JUDGE, AGRA
S.T. No. 45/2023  State v. Raju and others

PW-2 Sunita Devi
Examination-in-chief recorded on 22.01.2024

On 11.03.2023 at about 10 p.m. I heard shouts and came out of my house. I saw some persons running towards the railway crossing.

STATEMENT UNDER SECTION 161 Cr.P.C.

Statement of Ramesh Yadav s/o Hari Ram recorded on 14.03.2023 at P.S. Kotwali

On 11.03.2023 at about 10 p.m. I was returning home near the bus stand when I saw a crowd near the railway crossing.

STATEMENT UNDER SECTION 161 Cr.P.C.

Statement of Sunita Devi, aged 52 years, recorded on 15.03.2023 at P.S. Kotwali

I run a tea stall in Lohamandi market. I came to know about the incident the next morning.

UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
DISTRICT OF NEW JERSEY

Patel v. Rivera Logistics LLC, Civil Action No. 2:22-cv-01234

DECLARATION OF JOHN MILLER

I, John Miller, declare as follows:

1. On April 3, 2022, I was standing at the corner of Main Street and 5th Avenue.

2. At approximately 3:15 p.m., I saw a red pickup truck enter the intersection against the red light.

3. The truck struck the plaintiff's sedan on the driver's side.

4. I did not see anyone else at the corner.

I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct. Executed on May 2, 2022.

DEPOSITION OF JOHN MILLER

Taken on November 15, 2022, at the offices of Hart & Cole LLP, Newark, New Jersey

traps: FIR '9 p.m.' and s.161 '9 pm' are the same time; FIR '11.03.2023' and s.161 '11 March 2023' the same date
FIR 'Rs 5,000' and s.161 'Rs. 5000/-' are the same amount
FIR 'near the Hanuman temple' and s.161 'near the temple' are the same place (one contains the other)
FIR police-station time '11.30 p.m.' and chief '11:30 pm' agree, and are never compared with the incident time
recording dates in headers ('recorded on', 'Date and time of report', 'Executed on', 'Taken on') are metadata, never testimony
the supplementary statement's date (18.03.2023) concerns the bag being shown, not the incident
Ramesh Yadav and PW-5 Sunita Devi are never compared with PW-1 / PW-2
deposition 13:4-5 'April 3, 2022' agrees with the declaration date
red truck vs blue truck and red light vs yellow light are SEMANTIC (model layer only), never deterministic
